channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz que votação do fim da 6x1 antes do segundo turno já está acordada com Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula states that the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 tax scale on fuels will be voted on before the second round of the 2026 elections, following an agreement with Alcolumbre. According to his statement, the matter has already been coordinated with the Senate president.

item.title: O que são 'fandoms', que se uniram por Lula e ganharam agradecimento em ato
item.description: At a rally on Paulista Avenue, Lula specifically thanked the 'Brazilian fandoms', acknowledging the organized mobilization of music fans who supported his re-election campaign. These volunteers leveraged their fanbases to expand the reach of the event and the PT's campaign.

item.title: Lula e Flávio participam de sabatinas; Senado pode votar PEC da 6x1
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participate in town halls and debates as the 2026 presidential runoff campaign gains momentum. The PEC for six arrives at the Senate for voting, as candidates intensify their public communication agenda.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio diz que candidato não acabará com aposentadoria
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), denied in a social media video that the presidential candidate intends to eliminate pensions, calling fake news messages warning about a possible loss of benefits. She emphasized that Flávio supports protecting retirees and reducing INSS lines, proposing the use of artificial intelligence to speed up service to beneficiaries. The statement occurs amid the electoral dispute and debate over the future of Social Security.

item.title: Relator no TSE reverte decisão de Kassio e libera canal de Janones
item.description: Supreme Electoral Court (TSE) minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva overturned a decision by the court's president, Kassio Nunes Marques, reinstating the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula'. Cueva deemed the evidence insufficient to justify suspending the group and referred the case to the full court.

item.title: Flávio propõe dar celular e fogão a trabalhador que fizer cursos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed a CPF-linked point system rewarding workers with electronics or cash for completing professional training courses. The plan aims to match worker skills with local job openings through collaboration with municipal and state governments.

item.title: Corregedor suspende decisão do presidente do TSE e reabilita ‘Exército do Lula’
item.description: The TSE corregador Villas Bôas Cueva suspended the decision by TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques to remove the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, reinstating the group supporting President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The ruling will be discussed in the TSE plenary.

item.title: Em ato na Paulista, Lula faz aceno a jovens e promete revolução tecnológica
item.description: Lula participated in a pro-reelection rally on Paulista Avenue and promised a technological revolution in a potential fourth term, emphasizing the importance of youth in political life. He also urged the elderly to vote in the runoff and criticized Jair Bolsonaro's management during the Covid-19 pandemic.

item.title: Flávio pede mais agilidade da Justiça Eleitoral contra “mentiras”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro urged the Electoral Justice to act faster against what he called 'lies' in Lula's campaign, referencing the 'Exército do Lula' group. The event was attended by the governor and mayor of São Paulo, as well as lawmakers. The TSE has already deemed the group's content as false.

item.title: Corregedor do TSE suspende preliminarmente decisão de Nunes Marques e libera canal 'Exército do Lula'; decisão final será do plenário
item.description: The General Rapporteur of the Electoral Justice, Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, provisionally suspended the decision of the President of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, who had ordered the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel. Nunes Marques acted on a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, arguing the channel spread content deemed false. Lula called the suspension absurd and questioned supposedly biased rulings by the TSE.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que canal da campanha de Lula no WhatsApp faz 'divulgação de mentiras em massa'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula's campaign of spreading lies through a WhatsApp channel, which was briefly suspended by the TSE. At an event in São Paulo, he denied cutting Bolsa Família and reaffirmed a real minimum wage increase.

item.title: O pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro a prefeitos paulistas no segundo turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) gathered mayors and councilors in São Paulo to strengthen his base ahead of the runoff, emphasizing a broad first-round win. Lula (PT) also visited the city, reiterating his new slogan and pushing for labor reforms. Both candidates focused on consolidating support ahead of the final stretch.

item.title: Relator no TSE derruba decisão de Nunes Marques e mantém no ar canal de Whatsapp 'Exército do Lula'
item.description: Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, TSE ombudsman, overturned Kassio Nunes Marques' decision suspending the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, following Flávio Bolsonaro's request. Cueva ordered the case to the plenary, keeping the channel active as Lula supporters share content. The group grew from 50,000 to over 3 million followers after the first round.

item.title: Ex-fundador do PT diz que metade dos metalúrgicos do ABC vai votar em Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Zé Maria, a former founding member of the PT, stated on a podcast that half of ABC metalworkers will vote for Flávio Bolsonaro due to disappointment with Lula. In a debate with José Genoino, he emphasized that workers support the PL not because they are 'idiots', but due to dissatisfaction with the PT leader. Genoino acknowledged that the PT's political project faces a historical crisis.

item.title: Lula saca a la calle una marea roja para emprender la remontada y ganar las elecciones
item.description: Following a partial setback in the first round, Lula mobilized a 'red tide' of young people, LGBTs, and progressives on Paulista Avenue, reaffirming his defense of democracy and promising to activate the 33 million abstentionists to reverse the election outcome. With only two weeks left, Lula's strategy aims to regain momentum through mass mobilization.

item.title: Canal de Janones é suspenso com 3,4 milhões; Tropa do Flávio tem 1,3 milhão
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' channel, created by Deputy André Janones to mobilize Lula supporters in the runoff, was suspended by the TSE with 3.4 million followers after disinformation accusations from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. Meanwhile, the 'Tropa do Flávio', by Deputy Nikolas Ferreira, has 1.3 million followers. The gap between the channels reached 2.1 million followers.

item.title: Durante ato em SP, Lula diz confiar na votação pelo fim da escala 6×1 no Senado
item.description: At an event in São Paulo, President Lula expressed confidence that the Senate will vote on the PEC ending the 6×1 workweek schedule, criticizing opponents like Flávio Bolsonaro. He also emphasized the need to mobilize voters who abstained in the first round for the upcoming runoff.

item.title: “São Paulo não quer ditadura”, diz Alckmin sobre Flávio
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin publicly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during an event with President Lula in São Paulo, stating that the state 'does not want dictatorship' and invoking the students killed in 1932 as symbols of resistance. Alckmin also attacked the alleged connection between Flávio Bolsonaro and Banco Master and criticized the film 'Dark Horse' as an attempt at electoral manipulation.

item.title: Governo Lula tenta driblar prazos para votar fim da 6 X 1
item.description: The Lula administration seeks to approve a constitutional amendment ending the 6 X 1 schedule in the Senate, aiming to expedite the process through a special calendar. The strategy involves submitting a request with 54 signatures to reduce the regimental procedure and enable voting in two rounds by mid-October, avoiding delays caused by the opposition. The proposal requires 49 favorable votes in each round for approval.

item.title: Flávio reúne Tarcísio e prefeitos em SP e diz esperar Justiça Eleitoral mais ágil contra fake news
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro meets with Tarcísio and mayors in São Paulo, calling for faster electoral justice action against fake news attributed to Lula's campaign.

item.title: Lula acredita em votação da 6x1 nesta quarta e prevê Ministério da Segurança Pública
item.description: Lula says the 6x1 voting in the Senate will be a test to verify the opposition's stance, especially Flávio Bolsonaro. He also highlighted the vote on the Public Security PEC, which would create the Ministry of Public Security, as a campaign strategy. Lula criticized the TSE decision to remove the 'Exército do Lula' channel on WhatsApp.

item.title: Lula diz que aliados “enterraram” Ciro Gomes e Ciro Nogueira
item.description: President Lula stated that political allies defeated Ciro Gomes and Ciro Nogueira in the 2026 elections, highlighting the victories of Elmano de Freitas in Ceará and Rafael Fonteles in Piauí.

item.title: Leia a íntegra de documentos do TSE que derrubaram “Exército de Lula”
item.description: The TSE blocked the 'Exército de Lula' WhatsApp channel following a lawsuit from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, alleging the group spread misinformation and bypassed platform limits. Minister Nunes Marques ordered the channel's suspension within 3 hours, data preservation for 1 year, and investigation of potential electoral crimes involving André Janones and Meta.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: “Não vai ter fim de Bolsa Família”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, running for president with the PL party, reaffirmed his commitment to maintaining Bolsa Família and raising the minimum wage above inflation, dismissing rumors of ending the social program. He emphasized that it was expanded during his father Jair Bolsonaro's administration.

item.title: Ator de Leandro no filme sobre a dupla faz críticas a Flávio nas redes
item.description: Actor Eduardo Borelli, cast to portray Leandro in the biographical film about the duo Leandro & Leonardo, used Instagram to criticize presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), particularly his cultural proposals and new labor regime. He also shared a survey on Flávio's votes in militia areas in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram o desempenho de Lula após primeiros números do segundo turno
item.description: Recent polls show that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) trails Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in four of the five presidential surveys released in the first week of the runoff, with Lula ranging between 47% and 48% and Flávio between 52% and 53%. The only exception is Vox, which puts Lula ahead with 44.2% against Flávio's 42.7%. The decisive vote is scheduled for October 25th.

item.title: Deputado propõe PEC da reforma do Judiciário que prevê mudança na forma de indicação de ministros
item.description: Deputy Danilo Forte (PP-CE) proposed a PEC to reform the Judiciary, including changes to the appointment of Supreme Court ministers. The initiative arises in an electoral context marked by the central role of the STF in the national debate.

item.title: Flávio promete manter Bolsa Família: “Bolsonaro triplicou”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) pledged to maintain the Bolsa Família during a campaign event in São Paulo, claiming his father, Jair Bolsonaro, had tripled the benefit. He criticized the 15.04% adjustment announced by Lula, calling it 'meager', and defended ongoing increases. His economic team is studying spending cuts between BRL 200 billion and BRL 250 billion.

item.title: Lula afirma que PT vai recorrer à Justiça contra decisão de Nunes Marques de suspender canal
item.description: President Lula announced that the PT will appeal to court against the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel ordered by Supreme Electoral Court minister Kassio Nunes Marques at the request of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. The decision was based on allegations of spreading fake news. Lula deemed the measure an undue interference by the Electoral Justice in the 2026 election.

item.title: Presidente critica decisão de Nunes Marques de derrubar canal ‘Exército do Lula’ no WhatsApp
item.description: President Lula criticized Minister Kássio Nunes Marques' decision ordering the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel on WhatsApp, claiming biased decisions against his candidacy. He stated that Electoral Justice should not interfere in elections and that his party will file a legal action to reverse the decision.

item.title: Votação do 6×1 tem que ser agora para mostrar o que o PL apoia, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula announced that the PL bill ending the 6x1 work schedule will be voted on in the Senate next Wednesday, aiming to expose the position of Flávio Bolsonaro's party before the runoff election. He emphasized that the vote allows voters to know candidates' stances on labor issues.

item.title: Flávio afirma que 'ninguém vai tocar' em programas sociais como o Bolsa Família, mas não explica ajuste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed he would not cut social programs like Bolsa Família, but did not explain where budget cuts to control public debt would come from. He criticized Lula's campaign for spreading misinformation and accused PT of using lies to stay in power.

item.title: PT elege seus culpados após a derrota de Lula no primeiro turno
item.description: Following Lula's first-round loss, the PT and allies pointed to figures like Edinho Silva and Sidônio Palmeira as scapegoats amid internal criticism. The campaign was restructured with new advisors and communication strategies to reverse the electoral scenario.

item.title: Flávio vai contra valores judaicos, diz ministra judia de Lula
item.description: Minister of Management Esther Dweck criticized on Saturday (10) those who invoke Jewish identity to support Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), during an event by the group Jews and Jewesses for Democracy in São Paulo. She stated that the candidate's positions contradict Jewish values.

item.title: Cenário de euforia no mercado só se sustenta com ajuste fiscal, dizem economistas
item.description: Economists emphasize that market enthusiasm for Flávio Bolsonaro's lead over Lula in the first round depends on a rigorous fiscal adjustment agenda. The positive reaction is reflected in falling futures rates, the stock exchange surpassing 200,000 points, and the dollar weakening below R$ 5; however, experts warn this optimism will only be sustainable through disciplined fiscal consolidation policies.

item.title: PT quer descobrir quem gravou áudio de Vorcaro sobre filme de Lula
item.description: The PT requested the Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office to identify individuals who visited Daniel Vorcaro in prison and used audio recording equipment. The campaign is investigating a possible breach of professional secrecy related to the audio about Lula's film.

item.title: As viagens que Michelle Bolsonaro planeja para a campanha do 2º turno
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro plans trips to Brazilian capitals during the runoff campaign, focusing on the Northeast to support Flávio Bolsonaro and allied gubernatorial candidates. With backing from Damares Alves, the former first lady aims to mobilize female and evangelical voters while balancing campaigning with caring for Jair Bolsonaro's health, who is under house arrest. Her itinerary includes supporting Professora Maria do Carmo's Amazonas gubernatorial bid.

item.title: A capa Vorcaro-Lula mostra que VEJA tem lado, sim: o da fiscalização dos poderosos
item.description: VEJA cover story exposes alleged kickbacks between Daniel Vorcaro, Lula and the Lula Institute, sparking misinformation wave. Despite attacks, facts like audio and documents confirm parts of the allegations, pointing to influence from figures like Alexandre Padilha.

item.title: TSE suspende propaganda eleitoral de Lula que liga Flávio ao Caso Master
item.description: The TSE suspended Lula's electoral advertisement linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master Case investigation, deeming the claims as unfounded criminal accusations. The ad also referenced Flávio's running mate, Alfredo Gaspar, in an investigation for rape of a vulnerable person.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cria site 'anti-fake news' em que se compromete com ajuste do mínimo pela inflação
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) launched a website to combat fake news and, in his government plan, does not promise a real increase in the minimum wage, pledging only an adjustment based on inflation. The initiative reinforces his campaign focused on the economy and fighting misinformation.

item.title: Lula e Flávio terão desafios distintos para governar
item.description: In the October 25 runoff, the race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) poses distinct governing challenges. Lula seeks re-election for a fourth term, tackling inflation, public security and structural reforms; Flávio must consolidate a conservative agenda focused on security, economic liberalization and traditional social stances. Both candidates will need to build congressional alliances to advance their governing agendas.

item.title: Flávio venceu em 86% dos locais de votação em áreas de milícias no Rio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro won 86% of polling stations in areas controlled or influenced by militias in Rio de Janeiro, outperforming Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The analysis, based on the Armed Groups Map, reveals strong ties between the Bolsonaro family and militias, including staffing and parliamentary amendments benefiting individuals linked to criminal organizations. The race reflects deep polarization and historical connections between political power and armed groups in the state.

item.title: Ala do STF vê Lei da Dosimetria como alternativa à revisão criminal de Bolsonaro
item.description: A wing of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) supports reviewing the 'Dosimetry Law' as an alternative to criminal revision requests filed by Jair Bolsonaro, who seeks to annul his conviction in the coup plot. The law, enacted in 2025, allows sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. The dosimetry review is seen as more feasible in the Court than criminal revision, which would require overturning a established ruling by the First Panel.

item.title: 'Mea culpa' petista vai além da campanha: os erros de gestão e articulação que custaram caro a Lula no 1º turno
item.description: After falling behind in the first round, the PT reflects on governance and campaign mistakes, including outdated strategy and external interference. Criticism highlights failure to counter Flávio Bolsonaro and overemphasis on past achievements versus future proposals.

item.title: PL tem crescimento expressivo na Câmara puxado por discurso ideológico e verba pública
item.description: The PL leads the Chamber with the largest bureau, driven by ideological discourse, public funding, and high re-election rates. Candidates such as Nikolas Ferreira, André Fernandes, and Julia Zanatta increased votes and resources, while pre-Bolsonaro figures like Altineu Côrtes and Luiz Carlos Motta were also re-elected with growth in amendments.

item.title: 'Nunca funciona dizer que a economia vai bem se o eleitor não sente isso', aconselha Karl Rove, arquiteto das vitórias de Bush
item.description: Karl Rove, a Republican strategist, advises re-election candidates to avoid disconnecting favorable economic indicators from voter perceptions. He emphasizes empathy and realism in campaigns, citing examples in the US and Brazil. His analysis is part of the 'Brazil through foreign eyes' series examining international lessons for local elections.

item.title: Vitória de Flávio no 1º turno faz PL articular anistia para tirar Jair Bolsonaro da prisão em 2026
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's first-round victory reignited discussions about a potential amnesty for Jair Bolsonaro, with the PL and allies in Congress seeking parliamentary support. With a majority of legislators, the party explores avenues to overturn the former president's conviction for attempted coup, alongside negotiations with the STF and evangelical campaigning. The strategy aims for Jair to be released by 2026 and attend his son's inauguration in 2027.

item.title: Tarcísio projeta reforma no secretariado em SP com menos espaço para o PSD de Kassab
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas plans to reform his São Paulo cabinet after his second term inauguration, aiming to reduce the influence of the PSD, which had significant representation in his first term. The "less politicized" approach in public security is expected to continue, while changes in the Health Secretariat are under review. The governor is set to distance himself from the PSD president, Gilberto Kassab, and prioritize allies with fewer electoral ties.

item.title: Flávio e Lula disputam 706 mil votos "sem dono" no DF e Entorno
item.description: In the first round of the presidential election, over 706,000 voters in the Federal District and surrounding areas cast blank or null votes. Flávio Bolsonaro led with 51.31% in the DF, defeating Lula, who received 38.11% of the votes. High abstention rates may influence the runoff between the two candidates.

item.title: O que são "fandoms", grupos que fazem ato pró-Lula no MASP neste domingo
item.description: Fandoms are fan groups that form parasocial relationships with idols, organizing supportive events such as the pro-Lula rally at MASP. These collectives also promote social actions and influence legislation, showing strong digital and cultural engagement.
